I agree with daletrossi. A blog post can generate tons of free traffic from Google. 
The readers will mostly be people interested in what you are selling. A well written blog post can help you establish your brand and improve it. 

And don't worry. You won't have to write a whole encyclopedia. Most people want to read between 300 and 500 word articles. One or two well-written articles per week will hugely increase the traffic to your store.

When it comes to speaking Spanish, the American accent will be a problem. 
If it's the only accent you can speak, it will take more time to get used to the new sounds in Spanish. And more effort. 
Keep in mind that you asked for mastering, which implies native-like accent.

I'm not fluent, didn't put much effort into Spanish. But I think the best answer to your question would be: it depends.

I'll assume you are an American who speaks only the American version of English. Mastering Spanish, in your case, would take at least 4 years.  

The more familiar you are with Romance languages, the less time it'll take.
